name: Masonry wall repair and room renovation

mentions.name: Masonry wall repair and room renovation
mentions.description: This is a hands-on masonry and renovation project repairing walls in three rooms: reinstalling dozens of loose bricks, installing around 30 power outlets, replacing old windows with bigger modern ones, fixing door openings, and plastering everything afterwards. The work is done by the author personally, which keeps costs down, and is noted as very hard labor despite being interesting because it differs from their day job.
mentions.problem: Deteriorating walls with bricks falling off, plus outdated windows, too few power outlets, and worn door openings that need repair and plastering.
mentions.audience: Repairing the author's own living space, done personally as a break from their day job and to pay for a new car in cash rather than hiring out
mentions.source_excerpt: But I am doing something completely different - masonry. Repairing walls in 3 rooms. It includes reinstalling dozens of falling off bricks, installing 30 or so power outlets, replacing old windows with bigger modern ones, fixing openings for the doors and plastering everything afterwards.
